```{r Extract Data from OmicSignature Objects}
results_dir <- "/restricted/projectnb/agedisease/projects/challenge2025/results/Tabula_sapiens"

TabSapiens_AgingSignature_Collection_MAST_sim <- readRDS(paste0(results_dir,"/MAST/simple_regression/Tabula_Sapiens_Aging_OmicSignatureCollection.rds"))
TabSapiens_AgingSignature_Collection_MAST_adv <- readRDS(paste0(results_dir,"/MAST/advanced_regression/Tabula_Sapiens_Aging_OmicSignatureCollection.rds"))
TabSapiens_AgingSignature_Collection_DESeq2 <- readRDS(paste0(results_dir,"/DESeq2/TabulaSapiens_aging_omic_col.rds"))
TabSapiens_AgingSignature_Collection_MAST_cons <- readRDS(paste0(results_dir,"/MAST/consenus_regression/Tabula_Sapiens_Aging_OmicSignatureCollection.rds"))
```

```{r Create OmicSignature Collection from indivual Objects}
omic_signature_output_path <- file.path("/restricted/projectnb/agedisease/projects/challenge2025/results/Tabula_sapiens/MAST/consenus_regression_slow_incomplete")

message(paste0("Looking for individual OmicSignature .rds files in: ", omic_signature_output_path))

# Find all individual OmicSignature .rds files in that directory.
individual_sig_files <- list.files(omic_signature_output_path, 
                                   pattern = "aging_signature_.*_oSig\\.rds$", 
                                   full.names = TRUE)

# Load each of these .rds files and put them into a list.
all_tissue_omicsigs_for_collection <- list()
for (file_path in individual_sig_files) {
  # Get the tissue name from the file name.
  tissue_name <- gsub("aging_signature_|_oSig\\.rds$", "", basename(file_path))
  omic_sig_object <- readRDS(file_path)
  
  # Make sure what we loaded is actually an OmicSignature object
  if (inherits(omic_sig_object, "OmicSignature")) {
    all_tissue_omicsigs_for_collection[[tissue_name]] <- omic_sig_object
  } else {
    warning(paste0("The file '", basename(file_path), "' doesn't seem to be an OmicSignature object. It will be skipped."))
  }
}

# Define some information (metadata) for the whole collection.
omicsig_collection_metadata <- list(
  collection_name = "Tabula Sapiens Human Aging Signatures - All Tissues", 
  description = paste0("A collection of aging signatures from Tabula Sapiens human single-cell RNA-seq data, grouped by tissue. ",
                       "These were made using MAST analysis and then put together into this collection."),
  organism = "Homo sapiens",
  direction_type = "bi-directional",
  phenotype = "Aging",
  assay_type = "transcriptomics",
  platform = "transcriptomics by single-cell RNA-seq",
  author = "BU_Bioinformatics_ChallengeProject2025",
  year = as.numeric(format(Sys.Date(), "%Y")),
  keywords = c("Aging", "Tabula Sapiens", "single-cell", "MAST", "human", "sapiens")
)

# Create the OmicSignatureCollection object using the metadata and list of loaded signatures.
aging_signature_collection <- OmicSignatureCollection$new(
  metadata = omicsig_collection_metadata,
  OmicSigList = all_tissue_omicsigs_for_collection 
)

output_collection_file <- file.path(omic_signature_output_path, "Tabula_Sapiens_Aging_OmicSignatureCollection.rds")
saveRDS(aging_signature_collection, file = output_collection_file)

```


```{r Get significant nr of genes for all tissues in all datasets and plot data}
# --- Helper function to extract significant gene counts from an OmicSignature object ---
get_sig_gene_counts <- function(omic_sig_obj) {
  # Try to get tissue name from 'sample_type', otherwise fallback to 'signature_name'
  tissue_name <- omic_sig_obj$metadata$signature_name
  
  pattern_to_remove <- "Aging Signature - "
  tissue_name <- gsub(pattern_to_remove, "", tissue_name)
  
  # Count numbers of significatn genes from full dataframe
  adj_p_cutoff <- 0.05
  score_cutoff <- 0.25
  z_score_cutoff <- 2
  difexp <- omic_sig_obj$difexp
  print(colnames(difexp))
  if ('z_score_stat' %in% colnames(difexp)) {
    difexp_filtered <- difexp %>% dplyr::filter(adj_p <= adj_p_cutoff & abs(z_score_stat) >= z_score_cutoff)
  } else {
    difexp_filtered <- difexp %>% dplyr::filter(adj_p <= adj_p_cutoff & abs(score) >= score_cutoff)
  }
  # difexp_filtered <- difexp %>% dplyr::filter(adj_p <= adj_p_cutoff & abs(score) >= score_cutoff)

  num_sig_genes <- nrow(difexp_filtered)
  
  return(data.frame(
    tissue = as.character(tissue_name),
    num_sig_genes = as.numeric(num_sig_genes), # Ensure it's numeric
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ))
}

# --- Function to process an entire OmicSignatureCollection ---
process_omic_collection <- function(collection_obj, method_name) {
  # Use purrr::map_dfr to iterate and combine results cleanly
  all_tissue_counts_df <- purrr::map_dfr(collection_obj$OmicSigList, get_sig_gene_counts)
  
  # Add method name
  all_tissue_counts_df$method <- method_name
  
  # Crucial step: Aggregate by tissue and method.
  # If there are accidental duplicates for a (tissue, method) pair,
  # this sums their significant gene counts, preventing list-columns in pivot_wider.
  aggregated_df <- all_tissue_counts_df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(tissue, method) %>%
    dplyr::summarize(num_sig_genes = sum(num_sig_genes, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop')
  
  return(aggregated_df)
}

# --- Process each of the loaded collections ---
mast_sim_data <- process_omic_collection(TabSapiens_AgingSignature_Collection_MAST_sim, "MAST_Simple")
mast_adv_data <- process_omic_collection(TabSapiens_AgingSignature_Collection_MAST_adv, "MAST_Advanced")
deseq2_data <- process_omic_collection(TabSapiens_AgingSignature_Collection_DESeq2, "DESeq2")
mast_cons_data <- process_omic_collection(TabSapiens_AgingSignature_Collection_MAST_cons, "MAST_Consensus")
mast_cons_slow_data <- process_omic_collection(TabSapiens_AgingSignature_Collection_MAST_cons_slow, "MAST_Consensus_slow")


# --- Combine all data frames into one ---
all_methods_data <- rbind(mast_sim_data, mast_adv_data, deseq2_data, mast_cons_data, mast_cons_slow_data)


# --- Reshape the data for plotting: wide format with each method as a column ---
plot_ready_data <- all_methods_data %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = method,
    values_from = num_sig_genes,
    id_cols = tissue # Make sure to keep tissue as the identifier
  )

print("Data for plotting prepared (head):")
head(plot_ready_data)
# You can also check the structure to confirm column types are numeric:
# str(plot_ready_data)

# Ensure all columns used for plotting are numeric
plot_ready_data$MAST_Simple <- as.numeric(plot_ready_data$MAST_Simple)
plot_ready_data$MAST_Advanced <- as.numeric(plot_ready_data$MAST_Advanced)
plot_ready_data$DESeq2 <- as.numeric(plot_ready_data$DESeq2)
plot_ready_data$MAST_consensus <- as.numeric(plot_ready_data$MAST_Consensus)
plot_ready_data$MAST_consensus_slow <- as.numeric(plot_ready_data$MAST_Consensus_slow)


# --- Scatter Plot 1: MAST Simple vs. MAST Advanced ---
plot1 <- ggplot(plot_ready_data, aes(x = MAST_Simple, y = MAST_Advanced)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 3, color = "darkgreen") + # Add points
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "blue", linetype = "dashed") + # Add a linear regression line
  # Label points with tissue names, adjusting position for better visibility
  geom_text(aes(label = tissue), vjust = -1.2, hjust = 0.5, size = 2.5, check_overlap = TRUE, color = "grey30") + 
  labs(
    title = "Significant Genes: MAST Simple vs. MAST Advanced",
    x = "Number of Significant Genes (MAST Simple)",
    y = "Number of Significant Genes (MAST Advanced)",
    subtitle = "Each point represents a tissue"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5), plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) + # Center titles
  # Optional: Make sure axes start at 0 if appropriate for gene counts
  expand_limits(x = 0, y = 0) 

print(plot1)

# --- Scatter Plot 2: MAST Simple vs. DESeq2 ---
plot2 <- ggplot(plot_ready_data, aes(x = MAST_Simple, y = DESeq2)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 3, color = "darkred") + # Add points

  # Optional: Make sure axes start at 0 if appropriate for gene counts

print(plot2)
```
